fix: Fixed the host failing to bind the plugin service after enabling it in the plugin center; the "Inspect file" action is now available immediately after enabling
improvement: Streamlined the plugin name and description so the user-facing documentation reads more naturally

hint: First public release; requires AutoJs6 version code {{ required_host_build }} or later
feature: Added the read-only "Inspect file" action to the AutoJs6 file manager's file menu, working on regular files of any type (plugin ID `file-inspector`, action ID `inspect-file`)
One sequential read computes the {{ algorithm_list }} checksums together, with live progress plus cancel and retry

Paste an expected checksum for integrity verification: the algorithm is detected by length or by prefixes such as `sha256:`, fingerprint notation like `AB:CD:EF` and the CRC32 `0x` prefix are accepted, and comparison is constant-time over equal-length values
The report shows the file name, MIME type, extension, declared and actual sizes, a hex + ASCII snapshot of the first {{ header_bytes }} bytes, and UTF BOM detection
Recognizes 10 common formats from leading signature bytes: {{ supported_formats_v1_0_0 }}
Each checksum can be copied individually, the full report can be copied or shared through the system share sheet, and MD5 and SHA-1 carry a Legacy badge
The plugin requests no storage or network permission and reads files only through the temporary read-only content URI granted by the host, up to {{ max_input_size }} per file

Ships UI text, instructions, README, and CHANGELOG in 10 languages: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong), Traditional Chinese (Taiwan), English, French, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Russian, and Arabic
